# Used but not proven, by priority (generated by tools/metal/matrix.sh — do not edit)

Rows that are proven, used=no, closed, summary rows or reference-only (D3DMetal) rows are not ranked. Format and rules: `docs/metal/symptom-format.md`. Mac rows use symptom and cost directly from the Mac matrix.
